 Print Music composer Anirudh Ravichander has been making news in both his professional and personal life. One of the most popular composers in the Tamil film industry, Anirudh has made some successful albums and still works with some of the biggest names in the film industry. Amid the hype around his upcoming marriage to producer Kalanithi Maran ’s daughter Kavya Maran, an interview where Anirudh discussed his first school-day proposal is in the limelight. Anirudh Ravichander’s first proposal in school days
 In an old interview from when he was new in the film industry, Anirudh talked about his school life, his passion for music and his first proposal. According to Filmibeat, he said that he proposed to a girl in his school days but the relationship did not last long. Recalling the incident, the composer said, "I proposed to a girl when I was in school. But the affair ended just after three hours." He also discussed his experience of receiving proposals once he joined the movies. However, he acknowledged that his popularity as a composer played a major role in attracting attention. Watch Dhols, Crackers and Milk Abhishek: Rajinikanth Fans Celebrate Jailer 2 as Box Office Numbers Roll In Anirudh's Journey from school music classes to Tamil cinema
 During the same interview, Anirudh revealed that his parents enrolled him in music classes after noticing his interest in music. He clarified that they did not send him to classes with the intention of making him a music director. He was also good at academics and described himself as a quiet student until Class 8. He added that he became a little mischievous after that but remained a good student. Anirudh made his debut as a music composer with Dhanush's '3', directed by Aishwaryaa Rajinikanth. The song 'Why This Kolaveri Di' made him famous instantly across the entire country. Anirudh's career and upcoming projects
 Anirudh Ravichander is well known for his music to blockbuster South Indian films. Some of the biggest actors he has collaborated with include 'Jailer,' 'Vikram,' 'Leo,' 'Jawan,' and 'Jailer 2.' He has collaborated with several big personalities of the industry like Rajnikanth, Vijay , Kamal Hassan and others. Anirudh also has future plans for movies like 'Dharma' and others. Anirudh and Kavya Maran's wedding plans
 At the same time, Anirudh is getting ready to start a new phase of his personal life. He is all set to marry Kavya Maran, daughter of Sun Group Chairman Kalanithi Maran. The marriage is likely to take place in Greece on November 11, followed by a reception in Chennai on November 21. The marriage has certainly caught a lot of attention, and many prominent figures from both film and politics are likely to attend the ceremony.
